description: Metadata for an HIV antibody in LANL CATNAP: which region of the virus it binds (CD4 binding site, V3 glycan, MPER, …), its aliases, the paper that isolated it with PubMed id, light chain type, ADCC activity, and its mean panel IC50 with the number of viruses tested. Answers "what does PGT121 bind", "who isolated 10-1074", "how broad is this antibody's panel". For the per-strain measurements behind that panel, use catnap_search_neutralization.

name.description: Antibody name or alias, substring match, e.g. "VRC01", "PGT121".
